summary_en: 42,000 shares (0.02% of S/O) up to ¥90.0M. Execution window 1–7 Jul 2026. Method: ToSTNeT-3 market purchase. Stated rationale: flexible capital allocation and funding restricted stock awards.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Japan Elevator Service Holdings announced on 22 June 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 42,000 treasury shares (0.02% of shares outstanding, computed as 42,000 ÷ 178,763,918 ex-treasury shares) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥90.0 million. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 market purchase (覚書一任方式による東京証券取引所における市場買付け) during the window 1–7 July 2026. The stated purposes are to conduct flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the business environment and to fund awards under the company's restricted stock compensation plan (as separately disclosed in an announcement on the same date). The disclosure notes that as of 31 May 2026, the company held 20,082 treasury shares against 178,763,918 issued shares excluding treasury.
